title: Discount Codes, Bonus Items, App Access URL, Free Postage/No Returns Notices, and T&C/Privacy Policy Updates

requirements.text: Add a `DiscountCode` type and stable storage to the backend actor in `backend/main.mo` with fields: `id: Text`, `code: Text`, `discountType: { #percentage; #fixedAmount }`, `value: Float`, `active: Bool`, `createdAt: Int`. Implement admin-authenticated methods: `createDiscountCode(code, discountType, value)`, `updateDiscountCode(id, code, discountType, value, active)`, `deleteDiscountCode(id)`, `getDiscountCodes()` (admin), and a public `validateDiscountCode(code): ?DiscountCode` that returns the matching active code or null.

quotes: Admin interface in Dashboard > Payment Settings to create promo codes (percentage off or fixed amount) that customers can enter at checkout

acceptanceCriteria: Admin can create a discount code with a percentage type (e.g. 10%) or fixed amount type (e.g. $5.00 AUD)
Admin can update or delete existing discount codes
getDiscountCodes() returns all codes and is admin-only
validateDiscountCode() is publicly callable and returns the active code matching the provided string, or null if not found/inactive
Discount code data persists across canister upgrades via stable storage

requirements.text: Add a `BonusItemConfig` type and stable storage to the backend actor in `backend/main.mo` with fields: `title: Text`, `description: Text`, `url: Text`, `enabled: Bool`. Implement admin-authenticated methods `getBonusItemConfig()` and `updateBonusItemConfig(title, description, url, enabled)`. Also add a `proOcarinaAppUrl: Text` field to the same or a related `PaymentSettings` config record, with admin-authenticated getter `getPaymentSettings()` and setter `updatePaymentSettings(proOcarinaAppUrl, bonusItemConfig)`.

quotes: Configurable digital bonus item (app access link/download) in Dashboard > Payment Settings
A configurable URL field in Dashboard > Payment Settings so you can set the app link

acceptanceCriteria: getBonusItemConfig() returns the stored bonus item configuration
updateBonusItemConfig() is admin-only and persists changes
proOcarinaAppUrl is stored and retrievable from payment settings
All payment settings persist across canister upgrades via stable storage

requirements.text: Create React Query hooks in `frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts` for the new payment settings data: `useDiscountCodes()` (fetches all codes, admin-authenticated), `useCreateDiscountCode()`, `useUpdateDiscountCode()`, `useDeleteDiscountCode()` mutations (all admin-authenticated with cache invalidation), `useValidateDiscountCode()` mutation (public, no auth required), `usePaymentSettings()` (fetches bonus item config and pro app URL), and `useUpdatePaymentSettings()` mutation (admin-authenticated).

quotes: Admin interface in Dashboard > Payment Settings
A configurable URL field in Dashboard > Payment Settings

acceptanceCriteria: useDiscountCodes() fetches and caches the list of all discount codes
useCreateDiscountCode/useUpdateDiscountCode/useDeleteDiscountCode mutations call the correct backend methods and invalidate the discount codes cache
useValidateDiscountCode mutation is callable without authentication
usePaymentSettings() fetches bonus item config and pro app URL
useUpdatePaymentSettings mutation persists changes and invalidates the payment settings cache

requirements.text: Add a 'Payment Settings' tab to the admin Dashboard page (`frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx`). This tab must contain three sections: (1) **Discount Codes** — a table listing all existing promo codes (code, type, value, active status) with Edit and Delete buttons per row, plus a 'Create New Code' form with fields for code string, type selector (Percentage Off / Fixed Amount), value input, and active toggle; (2) **Bonus Item** — a form with fields for bonus item title, description, URL, and an enabled toggle; (3) **Pro Ocarina Learning App** — a single URL input field labelled 'Pro Ocarina Learning App URL'. All sections use the corresponding React Query hooks from REQ-129.

quotes: Admin interface in Dashboard > Payment Settings to create promo codes
Configurable digital bonus item (app access link/download) in Dashboard > Payment Settings
A configurable URL field in Dashboard > Payment Settings

acceptanceCriteria: A 'Payment Settings' tab is visible in the Dashboard page tab list
The Discount Codes section lists all codes with their type, value, and active status
Admin can create, edit (code string, type, value, active), and delete discount codes from the UI
The Bonus Item section allows the admin to configure and save a title, description, URL, and enabled toggle
The Pro Ocarina App section shows a URL input that saves to the backend payment settings
Save confirmations or error toasts are shown after each mutation

requirements.text: Add a discount code entry field to the Checkout page (`frontend/src/pages/Checkout.tsx`). Display an input labelled 'Promo Code' with an 'Apply' button. When applied, call `useValidateDiscountCode()` to validate the code: if valid, display the discount amount and update the displayed order total accordingly; if invalid or inactive, show an inline error message. Pass the validated discount code value to the Stripe checkout session creation call so the discount is reflected in the Stripe session line items or coupon.
acceptanceCriteria: A 'Promo Code' input and 'Apply' button are visible on the Checkout page
Entering a valid active code shows the discount amount and reduced total
Entering an invalid or inactive code shows a clear error message
The discount is passed through to the Stripe checkout session (as a coupon or adjusted line item amount)
Removing or changing the code clears the applied discount

requirements.text: Update the Payment Success page (`frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccess.tsx`) to display the configured bonus item and Pro Ocarina Learning App URL after a successful purchase. Fetch payment settings using `usePaymentSettings()`. If the bonus item is enabled, display its title, description, and a clearly labelled link/button to access the bonus item URL. Always display a dedicated section for the Pro Ocarina Learning App with a labelled link to the configured URL (e.g. 'Access your free Pro Ocarina Learning App'). If the Pro Ocarina App URL is not yet configured, do not display that section.

quotes: automatically appears on every order confirmation/receipt
displayed on every order confirmation page

acceptanceCriteria: Payment success page fetches and displays the bonus item section when enabled, showing title, description, and clickable URL
Payment success page displays the Pro Ocarina Learning App link when the URL is configured
If bonus item is disabled, its section is not shown
If Pro Ocarina App URL is empty/unconfigured, that section is not shown
Both sections are clearly labelled and visually distinct from the standard confirmation message

requirements.text: Add static free postage and no returns policy notices to three locations in the frontend: (1) **Product Detail View** (`frontend/src/components/ProductDetailView.tsx`) — add a notice below the price reading '✓ Free postage on every order' and '✗ No returns accepted'; (2) **Checkout page** (`frontend/src/pages/Checkout.tsx`) — add a policy summary box in the order summary section stating 'Free postage included' and 'No returns policy applies to all purchases'; (3) **Payment Success page** (`frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccess.tsx`) — add a brief reminder 'Your order includes free postage. Please note: no returns are accepted.' These notices are static text and do not require backend configuration.

quotes: Static policy notices added to product pages, checkout, and order confirmation indicating free postage on every order and no returns accepted

acceptanceCriteria: ProductDetailView displays a free postage notice and a no returns notice below the price
Checkout page displays free postage and no returns notices in the order summary
PaymentSuccess page displays a brief free postage and no returns reminder
All notices are clearly readable and consistently styled with the existing theme

requirements.text: Update the Terms & Conditions page (`frontend/src/pages/Terms.tsx`) to add or update the following policy sections: (1) **Shipping** — state that free postage is included on every order with no minimum purchase required; (2) **Returns** — replace any existing returns text with a clear no-returns policy statement explaining all sales are final and no returns or refunds are accepted; (3) **Digital Inclusions** — add a new section stating that every purchase includes complimentary access to the Pro Ocarina Learning App, a digital tool for learning ocarina tablature and composing music.

quotes: Update existing T&C and Privacy Policy pages to include: free postage on all orders, access to the Pro Ocarina Learning App included with every purchase, and no returns policy

acceptanceCriteria: Terms & Conditions page includes a Shipping section stating free postage on all orders
Terms & Conditions page includes a Returns section with a clear no-returns/all-sales-final policy
Terms & Conditions page includes a Digital Inclusions section describing Pro Ocarina Learning App access included with every purchase
Existing sections that contradict the new policies (e.g. old returns language) are updated or removed

requirements.text: Update the Privacy Policy page (`frontend/src/pages/PrivacyPolicy.tsx`) to add or update the following sections: (1) **Order Fulfillment** — note that free postage is provided on all orders and no personal shipping cost data is collected for postage calculations; (2) **Digital Products & App Access** — add a section explaining that purchase records may be used to grant access to the Pro Ocarina Learning App, a digital learning tool included with every order; (3) **Returns & Refunds** — add a statement that no returns or refunds are processed, so no return-related personal data is collected.

quotes: Update existing T&C and Privacy Policy pages to include: free postage on all orders, access to the Pro Ocarina Learning App included with every purchase, and no returns policy

acceptanceCriteria: Privacy Policy page references free postage on all orders in the order fulfillment context
Privacy Policy page includes a section on digital product/app access and how purchase data relates to app access
Privacy Policy page includes a no-returns/no-refunds data statement
No existing required privacy sections (data collection, payment processing, user rights) are removed

constraints: Do not modify any file under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui
Discount code validation (validateDiscountCode) must be publicly callable without admin authentication so guest customers can apply codes at checkout
Free postage and no returns notices in REQ-133 are static frontend text only — no backend configuration required
All new backend stable storage must survive canister upgrades
nonGoals: Automatic Stripe coupon/discount code sync — discount is applied client-side to the session amount, not via Stripe's coupon API unless straightforward
Customer-facing discount code management (customers cannot create or list codes, only apply them)
Physical returns workflow or return shipping label generation
Email delivery of bonus item or app access link (display on confirmation page only)
Bulk import or export of discount codes
